title: Gastric cohort design and integrated atlas
question: Are donor, cohort, state, site and treatment roles identifiable without perfect state-cohort confounding?
acceptance_test: Every cell maps to one donor/sample; per-group donor counts reported; confounding and holdout plan explicit
notes: A large UMAP is not an acceptance test.

title: Recurrent malignant gastric meta-programs
question: Which malignant programs recur across donors and datasets?
acceptance_test: Programs stable across seeds and donor/cohort holdouts under a prespecified similarity rule
notes: Uses nonnegative input with frozen provenance.

title: Donor-level immune and stromal remodeling
question: Which ecosystem states associate with disease site after donor-level inference?
acceptance_test: Effect estimates use donor/sample units and report uncertainty; one-donor sites cannot support general claims
notes: GSE234129 alone currently fails the metastatic donor requirement.

title: Replicated spatial program niches
question: Do malignant and stromal programs form reproducible spatial neighborhoods?
acceptance_test: All sections run; discovery and validation separated; spatial null rejected and independent patients replicate direction
notes: No causal communication wording without perturbation.

title: Independent clinical and treatment projection
question: Do frozen programs associate with survival or modify treatment response?
acceptance_test: Endpoint and arms explicit; multivariable diagnostics pass; external effect and interaction reported with multiplicity control
notes: Negative results remain part of the Figure/source table.

title: Robust virtual perturbation candidates
question: Which genes consistently shift prespecified malignant or ecosystem states?
acceptance_test: Donor-disjoint model; stable across seeds/splits/alternative labels; beats expression/correlation baselines; orthogonal evidence reported
notes: Without experimental support use candidate language.

title: CRC precursor-primary-metastasis cohort design
question: Can normal/polyp/primary/liver-metastasis roles be separated from cohort, site and treatment?
acceptance_test: Every sample/donor and treatment maps uniquely; group counts and bridge/holdout design pass
notes: Must parse real archives before the contract is accepted.

title: Recurrent CRC malignant meta-programs
question: Which programs recur across precursor, primary and metastatic states?
acceptance_test: Programs survive seeds and donor/cohort holdouts; stage association is donor-level

title: CRC ecosystem remodeling across states
question: Which immune/stromal states differ at donor level?
acceptance_test: Donor-level effect estimates with treatment/site sensitivity analyses
notes: Cell counts cannot be inferential replicates.

title: Matched and replicated spatial metastatic niches
question: Which program neighborhoods differ between primary CRC and liver metastasis?
acceptance_test: Matching verified; all sections analyzed; spatial null and independent replication pass
notes: Source-paper claims using GSE225857 cannot be republished as new.

title: Independent clinical and treatment relevance
question: Do frozen programs associate with outcomes in independent CRC cohorts?
acceptance_test: Patient identity and endpoints pass; multivariable/external results and negative findings reported

title: Robust CRC virtual perturbation candidates
question: Which candidates shift prespecified states beyond simple baselines?
acceptance_test: Donor-disjoint stability, nulls, baselines and orthogonal validation pass
notes: Geneformer use is not itself the novelty or validation.

title: Qualified ICC cohort and recurrent programs
question: Can public ICC data support adequate donor groups and stable malignant programs?
acceptance_test: Every decisive group meets donor minimum and programs survive holdouts
notes: If this fails, the full route stops.

title: ICC ecosystem states
question: Which donor-level immune/stromal states associate with retained disease states?
acceptance_test: Donor-level effect estimates with cohort sensitivity pass
notes: Figure is dropped in a reduced route if data are inadequate.

title: ICC spatial and clinical validation
question: Do any retained programs replicate spatially and clinically?
acceptance_test: Independent patients, complete endpoints and appropriate spatial/clinical diagnostics pass
notes: Full route is blocked until a real dataset can complete this paper task.

title: ICC perturbation candidate prioritization
question: Can robust source/target states yield stable candidates?
acceptance_test: Pinned model, donor split, seeds, nulls, baselines and orthogonal checks pass
notes: Remove rather than fabricate if source/target states are weak.
